text:
incident-bot: HIGH SEV -> BlueBank (enterprise, VPC) gateway streaming errors >90% across ap-southeast. Error: websocket close 1006 / truncated frames. Paging oncall.

maya (SRE): acked. I'm on it. @aj are you oncall? grabbing logs and cluster view now.

aj (oncall): here, seeing alerts. Pager hit at 07:14 UTC. I can take first triage. Maya, can you share which pool this tenant was pinned to?

maya (SRE): BlueBank is on dedicated-pool-3 (rg-dedicated-03) in ap-southeast-1. I'm pulling kube logs for gateway pods now.

sam (platform): noticed spike in connections and a surge of stale clients earlier. Could be a client-side retry loop + our keepalive timing. Also saw TCP resets from the customer NAT.

maya (SRE): logs snippet:
```
2026-03-12T07:13:59Z gateway-1 WARN ws: client disconnect code=1006 reason="" conn_id=ab12c
2026-03-12T07:14:01Z gateway-2 ERR write: broken pipe conn_id=ab12c
2026-03-12T07:14:05Z gateway-1 WARN upstream: stream err: EOF
```

jess (acct-eng): BlueBank ops just DM'd their SRE, they're seeing partial messages and the app-level retries are aggressive. They've paused retries but still seeing 'connection lost' user incidents.

aj (oncall): initial hypothesis: BlueBank clients hitting intermittent network flaps inside their VPC -> frequent websocket disconnects -> client retries hammer gateway -> gateway kernel-level fd exhaustion on dedicated pool -> cascading 1006s. Need to confirm fd usage.

maya (SRE): checking node metrics. iostat/conntrack look okay, but file descriptor usage on gateway-1 is at 92%. There's a rising pattern correlating with client's retry bursts.

sam (platform): also seeing increased goroutine stacks and slow flushes on write path. Suggest we throttle that tenant at the gateway level to give infra breathing room.

aj (oncall): agreed. Mitigation plan (short term): 1) temporary tenant rate-limit and circuit-break (reduce concurrent streams, increase per-connection write timeout). 2) fallback traffic to hosted-gateway fallback if isolation needed. 3) coordinate with BlueBank to adjust client retry backoff. Who owns executing fallback?

maya (SRE): I can apply a tenant-scoped policy via the control plane. Command:
```
# apply a soft circuit-breaker for tenant bluebank
redwoodctl tenant update --tenant bluebank --policy "max_streams=20,conn_rate=10/min,write_timeout=8s"
```
I'll run in a minute after notif to acct-eng because this is intrusive.

jess (acct-eng): pls do it, but DM me before. Also please post what we changed so I can update the customer.

mia (typo? not present) -- skip.

aj (oncall): while maya applies policy, I'll open a temporary routing override to send new connections to hosted fallback in eu region. That reduces pressure on dedicated pool. Sam can you validate compatibility of hosted variant with BlueBank auth headers?

sam (platform): hosted accepts same auth token format, but streaming idle-timeouts differ (hosted keepalive 30s). We should add a proxy header to indicate origin. I'll prepare the route patch.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline started -> canary rollback applied to routing service (route-bluebank -> hosted fallback) by aj @ 07:28 UTC

deploy-bot: canary OK -> 2/2 healthy -> traffic shift at 07:31 UTC

aj (oncall): routing change pushed. New connections are landing on hosted fallback. Metrics show outgoing connections to dedicated pool dropping ~78%.

maya (SRE): fd usage on gateway-1 down to 68% after throttling and routing shift. Error spikes reduced to ~12%.

jess (acct-eng): BlueBank ops confirms decreased error rates on their end and fewer customer complaints. They're requesting a timeline and root-cause analysis.

aj (oncall): next: do we want to keep hosted fallback for 24-48h while BlueBank performs network remediation, or restore them when their ops confirms stable NAT behavior?

maya (SRE): recommend 48h precaution. Also schedule a dedicated pool hotfix: increase epoll backlog and add per-tenant aggresive eviction for half-open conns. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

sam (platform): noted. For the hotfix: increase keepalive and implement exponential backoff recognition header so gateway can slow clients that misbehave. Proposed change:
```
- tcp_keepalive = 60 -> 120
- ws_write_timeout = 8s -> 12s
- per_tenant_concurrency_limit enforcement tightened
```

aj (oncall): handoff: I'm out at 08:00 UTC. @maya will be primary. Handoff checklist:
- incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/1719001111 (updating)
- mitigation applied: tenant policy + routing fallback
- customer notify: jess to own comms
- SRE follow-up: maya to open infra ticket for kernel/fd tweaks

maya (SRE): taking owner. I'll add timeline notes and link to logs. Also will run lighter load test against dedicated-pool-3 to validate fixes.

jess (acct-eng): I'm drafting a customer message: short, non-technical, timeline + mitigation + ask for their network team to increase NAT socket pools and extend retry backoff. Will send once I have the exact policy details.

aj (oncall): FYI @platform @sre, paging escalation to Level 2 if errors >20% in next 2h. set pager to L2 if threshold breached.

incident-bot: NOTE: alert threshold updated -> escalate to L2 after 20% error rate sustained 5m.

maya (SRE): running a focused heap/profile on gateway-1. No obvious memory leak; looks IO-bound. Opening ticket INF-4458 -> "BlueBank VPC gateway streaming FD pressure" and assigning to eng-runtime.

sam (platform): i've queued the route rollback plan with feature-flag so we can bring them back to dedicated quickly once customer confirms. Also adding a metric to detect client retry storm (X-Retry header count) so we can proactively throttle.

jess (acct-eng): customer call scheduled 08:40 UTC with BlueBank ops+Redwood account team. I'll ask them to share NAT gateway logs and client retry policy. They said many clients are mobile and on flaky carriers.

maya (SRE): final note for thread: mitigation sequence worked. Keep hosted fallback for now. Will follow up in incident doc with RCA and long-term remediations (kernel tuning, per-tenant circuit-breakers, client retry guidance). Assign follow-ups to eng-runtime and acct-eng.

aj (oncall): handing off to maya. I'm reachable on DMs for rollbacks. Good job team. :thumbsup:

maya (SRE): thanks. closing active paging. I'll update when follow-ups scheduled.

deploy-bot: Incident channel annotation -> incident status: mitigated -> 07:45 UTC

maya (SRE): 07:52 UTC: adding postmortem template and next steps to INF-4458. Will include timeline, mitigation commands, customer comms draft, and test plan for hotfix.
